slip_predict — DRIVE roverslip op

• Data kinds: table × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.slip_predict(model, slopes, level: 'float' = 0.9) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import roverslip; roverslip.slip_predict(model, slopes, level: 'float' = 0.9) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("slip_predict"))

Usage

Slip-ratio prediction and a two-sided level band. For the Gaussian process, the predictive distribution of observations (latent variance + noise); for quantile regression, the curves themselves.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値 {"mean", "std", "lower", "upper", "median", "level"}(各 (n,))。分位点回帰の mean は当てはめた分位点の平均、std は四分位範囲 / 1.349、帯の端は (1 ± level)/2 の分位点(当てはめた段に無ければ ValueError)に、共形の補正(slip_quantile_fit の conformal)があればその幅を足す。
